sourceSnapshots.title: Optimising Site Capacity: A Design-led Approach LPG
sourceSnapshots.authorityNote: Guidance supporting Policy D3; not itself London Plan policy and not to be promoted into statutory development-plan status.

sourceSnapshots.title: Housing Design Standards LPG
sourceSnapshots.authorityNote: Guidance interpreting London Plan housing-design policies; departures are material to decision-making but the LPG should not be applied mechanistically.

methodClasses.claimBoundary: Evaluates an explicit numeric London Plan policy standard from admitted proposal facts. It does not decide the overall planning balance.
The compiler can organise source, facts and evidence but cannot convert design/context judgement into a scalar pass score.
The compiler can expose the policy duty and evidence required; qualitative inclusive-design adequacy remains judgement-led.

Planning policy/condition assigns an optional Building Regulations dwelling category. The compiler may transmit that resolved requirement to the building-control target but may not invent the assignment.

obligations.title: Optimise site capacity through a design-led response to context and infrastructure
requiredInputs: design-option rationale proportionate to the proposal
obligations.nonClaim: No density, character or design-quality score is created. Compatibility before adaptation remains the Reference House response to site pressure.

obligations.title: Highest standards of accessible and inclusive design
requiredInputs: inclusive-design rationale proportionate to development scale/type
barrier-free use evidence appropriate to proposal
design and access / inclusive-design statement where required
obligations.nonClaim: A machine-readable M4 category or a level threshold does not by itself discharge the qualitative D5 duty.

obligations.title: Minimum gross internal area and built-in storage
obligations.deterministicRule: Lookup minimums from spaceTable for exact bedroom/bedspace/storey tuple; compare policyDefinedGIA and builtInStorageArea independently.
obligations.currentReferenceHouseNote: The Reference House currently selects four upper-floor bedrooms and two principal storeys, but planning bedspace count and policy-measured GIA/storage are not yet frozen at DPL authority; therefore no D6 pass is claimed.

obligations.title: Minimum 2.5 m floor-to-ceiling height over at least 75% of dwelling GIA
obligations.nonClaim: The Reference House 3300 mm floor-to-floor datum is not equivalent to finished floor-to-ceiling height.

obligations.title: Minimum private outdoor space where no higher borough standard applies
obligations.deterministicRule: London baseline area = 5 sqm for 1-2 persons + 1 sqm for each additional person; qualifying space must achieve at least 1.5 m depth and 1.5 m width. A higher borough standard, if applicable, is composed separately and is not overwritten by this check.

obligations.title: Accessible/adaptable and wheelchair-user dwelling mix
obligations.crossTargetOutput: When planning authority/proposal evidence resolves an individual dwelling category, emit that exact M4 category as an input obligation to the England building-control target.
obligations.singleDwellingGuardrail: Do not assign M4(2) or M4(3) to a single dwelling by naive percentage rounding in this strategic slice. Preserve the strategic mix requirement and await the planning proposal/condition/local application decision that identifies the dwelling category.
obligations.nonClaim: A resolved planning category does not itself prove compliance with the corresponding Building Regulations technical standard.
